S tylish, sporty, and fun
With agile handling and a 1.6L Gasoline Direct Injection (GDI) four-cylinder engine that delivers 138
horsepower, the 2017 Kia Rio makes driving enjoyable mile after mile. Rio is available as both a sedan
and a 5-Door hatchback, which features an ideal combination of real-world functionality and unique
styling. Both models also offer available advanced features that increase your entertainment
options and enhance everyday convenience. Like all Kia models, Rio comes with an industry-leading
10-year/100,000-mile warranty program,1 a testament to its quality and reliability.

Spacious and versatile
Rio 5-Door offers the best of all worlds. Its fifth door gives you the convenience of a hatchback, while
a variety of easily adjustable seating configurations let you carry passengers, cargo, or a combination
of both.2 Plus, it includes sporty exterior features like projection headlights and a rear spoiler.
1 2 3 4
1 . HATCHBACK DESIGN
Carrying anything from gardening
supplies to camping equipment for
a weekend getaway is easy with
Rio 5-Door. Its rear seats fold flat
to create a spacious cargo area.2
2. 60/40 SPLIT-FOLDING REAR SEATS
The rear seats feature a 60/40 split-
folding design, and they fold up or down
quickly and conveniently for maximum
cargo space and seating versatility.
3. CONCEALED STORAGE
Rio 5-Door has a built-in cargo cover
that lets you store your valuable items
safely out of sight. Rio 5-Door EX and
SX also feature a cargo net and under-
floor luggage tray hidden beneath the
cargo area floor, so you can keep your
items secure and organized.
4. COVERED CENTER CONSOLE
The driver and front passenger will
appreciate the dual cup holders
and storage bin with available sliding
armrest.* The storage bin allows
personal items to be kept close at hand.

ADVANCED AIRBAG SYSTEM
An advanced airbag system helps
protect driver and passengers with
dual front, front seat-mounted
side, and full-length side curtain
airbags and is complemented by a
driver’s knee airbag1.4
AIRBAG & SEAT-BELT SENSORS
This advanced system monitors
the severity of certain impacts, the
presence of a front passenger and
seat-belt use, and then controls
airbag inflation accordingly.14
FRONT SEAT-BELT PRETENSIONERS
Pretensioners have been designed
to tighten the front seat belts in the
event of certain collisions. This can
help to reduce the likelihood of injuries.
HEIGHT-ADJUSTABLE
SEAT-BELT ANCHORS
The front height-adjustable seat-belt
anchors allow the driver’s and front-
passenger’s seat belts to be raised
and lowered for a proper fit.
FRONT & REAR CRUMPLE ZONES
Both front and rear crumple zones
are engineered to help absorb and
dissipate impact energy, helping
to preserve the basic structural
integrity of the vehicle’s passenger
compartment in certain collisions.
